tsp cake batter extract  tangzhong 3 cups bread flour (360g), plus up to ½ cup (60g) as needed 2 tbsp milk powder (15g) ¾ tsp salt (4g) mix the warm milk, sugar, and yeast together and let sit for rectangle, keeping it about ¾ inch thick. spread the sugar cookie dough evenly over the surface. sprinkle Christmas nonpareils over the sugar cookie layer. cut the dough into approximately 12 strips, Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Warning: these Grinch cookie butter cinnamon rolls may cause your heart to grow 3 sizes 💚💚💚 🎄recipe🎄 Dough: ﻿﻿1 cup warm whole milk  ﻿﻿3 tsp active dry yeast ﻿﻿⅓ cup light brown sugar ﻿﻿⅓ cup unsalted butter (melted) ﻿﻿1 tsp vanilla extract ﻿﻿2 large eggs ﻿﻿4 cups  all-purpose ﻿﻿1 tsp salt 1-2 tbsp green food coloring Filling: ﻿﻿¼ cup unsalted butter (melted) ﻿﻿¼ cup cookie butter ﻿﻿½ cup light brown sugar ﻿﻿1 tbsp ground cinnamon Frosting: ﻿﻿8 oz cream cheese (room temperature) ﻿﻿¼ cup unsalted butter (room temperature) ﻿﻿¼ cup cookie butter ﻿﻿2 cups powdered sugar 1 tsp green food coloring Optional: ﻿﻿¼ cup heavy whipping cream (pour on rolls before baking) ﻿﻿Heart sprinkles/candy 🎄instructions🎄 -Heat the milk in 20-second intervals until it reaches 100–110°F. Stir in the yeast and let it sit for 5–10 minutes to bloom.  -In a large bowl (or the bowl of a stand mixer), add the melted butter, vanilla, eggs, and brown sugar. Mix until smooth, then pour in the activated milk-yeast mixture. -Add the flour, salt, and green food coloring. If mixing by hand, use a wooden spoon to bring the dough together, then knead on a floured surface for 10–12 minutes. -Place the dough in a greased bowl. Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Taco Mac & Cheese Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * 1 packet taco seasoning * 4 oz tomato sauce * ½ cup salsa * 16 oz shell pasta * 1 cup beef broth * 1 cup milk * 1½ cups Mexican blend cheese, divided * Optional: parsley for topping Instructions 1. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the ground beef with the taco seasoning until browned and fully cooked. 2. Add the tomato sauce and salsa, and stir until combined. 3. Add the uncooked shell pasta, beef broth, and milk. Mix well. 4. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. If the pasta needs more time, continue cooking and add a splash of broth or milk as needed. 5. Once pasta is cooked, stir in 1¼ cups of mexican cheese until melted. 6. Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup cheese over the top, cover, and let it melt. 7. Top with parsley if desired and serve warm! #easydinnerideas #dinnerideas #mealideas #dinner #onepanmeal

Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪 (Makes 9-10 Cookies)  Ingredients: - 1/2 cup (115g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled - 1/2 cup (100g) light brown sugar - 1/3 cup (67g) granulated sugar - 1 large egg, room temp - 1 tablespoon (15g) vanilla extract - 1 1/4 cups (160g) all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled - 1/2 teaspoon (2g) baking soda - Pinch of salt - 1 1/2 cups (190g) semi-sweet chocolate chips For Garnish: - Flaky sea salt ( optional ) Method: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside. 3. In a separate bowl, combine melted butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Whisk for 1-2 minutes until a smooth paste forms. 4. Crack in the egg and vanilla extract. Mix until well combined. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet batter and gently fold until just combined. 6. Add chocolate chips and mix with a spatula. Do not overmix the batter. 7. Scoop out 9 cookies onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 inches of space between each cookie. 8. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown and crispy on the edges and gooey in the center. 9. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with flaky sea salt. 10. Allow the cookies to cool completely on the baking sheet before serving. #cookies #chocolate #chocolatechip #cookie #cookiepie #cookie #cookierecipe #baking #teatime #CeramicLovers #viral #afternoontea #TeaTime #viralvideo #TeaLovers
